protocol.scope: Geometry-selected CT acquisition and expanded evaluation of the frozen 288-point merge5 sample
protocol.selection_rule: For each prior whole-height-grid row containing mask-valid points, choose the point nearest column984, breaking ties toward smaller x. Acquire the union of all eight candidates' missing slices for those six points. No target intensity or new residual used for this selection.
protocol.evaluation: Re-evaluate every original288 point against all8 unchanged candidates using the old6 plus newly verified36 slices. Preserve every missing/invalid status. Report six acquisition-anchor results separately, all288 denominators, exact/nonzero residuals, by-row coverage and common-set comparisons. Do not redraw or adjust any model parameter/tolerance after new values are read.
protocol.exact_match_criterion: Predicted integer maximum minus archived integer texture value equals zero at every evaluated point. Empty evaluated sets are not passes. Missing valid targets leave full spatial coverage incomplete; observed nonzero residuals remain failures even when coverage is incomplete.
protocol.prior_awareness: Old nine-point and wider sample outcomes known. Existing mapping/mask and published literary context known. This is a prospective new-measurement check, not a blind transcription or pristine held-out model-development experiment.
protocol.rights: Dataset declares CC BY-NC4.0; acquire limited measurement payloads privately outside Git. No redistribution under POB license, no generated or edited image output.
